facts.fact: 本章第一节的主角 Michele 痛恨上学，整年以学期为轴：六月最好、九月最糟。
facts.anchor: He hates school more than anything else, and the whole year revolves around it.

facts.fact: Michele 把九月开学联想到「变老与死亡」。
facts.anchor: In early September Michele understands what it means to grow old and die.

facts.fact: 叙述者用咖啡店里糕点的温度当作小镇淡季旺季的体温计。
facts.anchor: The pastries in the café are the thermometers which track the life and death of the season

facts.fact: 九月与一月（假期结束、明天开学）都是 Michele 眼中死亡的图像。
facts.anchor: September is an image of death, and so, in its own small way, is January, when the Christmas holidays end and a dreadful black vortex opens

facts.fact: 1 月 6 日早晨，Michele 走进起居室看见爸爸裤子上着火——他手里还夹着一支点着的烟。
facts.anchor: The first thing he sees is a flame on Papa’s trousers.

facts.fact: 父亲 Stefano 的病在近几个月加速恶化，已几乎无法协调动作。
facts.anchor: Over the last months the decay has been faster, so much so that by now he can barely coordinate his movements.

facts.fact: 妈妈最后说出这一天的名字：主显节（Befana）当日，即 1 月 6 日。
第二节把三条线拧在同一早晨：Michele 照顾父亲、Wendy 在纳沃纳广场卖魔法、罗马的孩子们。
facts.anchor: On the morning of the 6th of January, while Michele handles his father and Wendy sells magic in Piazza Navona, the children of Rome are all awake.

facts.fact: 法医在 San Basilio 取证：一个富家孩子清晨六点被发现死亡，另一个被打得可能永远站不起来。
facts.anchor: The forensics team is taking samples in one of the worst streets of San Basilio, where a rich kid has been found dead at six in the morning, with another beaten so badly that perhaps he’ll never walk again.

facts.fact: 在 Esquiline 山的一处地下室里，Giovanni 与 Luisa 正在做爱。
facts.anchor: in a basement on the Esquiline Hill, two young people are making love.

facts.fact: 「Fatty Bolger」这个绰号源自 Luisa 给 Giovanni 的导师起的外号。
facts.anchor: It was Luisa who first gave Giovanni’s supervisor a nickname based on a hobbit

facts.fact: Giovanni 为那篇期刊文章得不到报酬，只换来与导师共同署名。
facts.anchor: “Nothing, but we’re both putting our name on it.”

facts.fact: Giovanni 还剩 172 张哈欠照片要分析。
facts.anchor: I still have 172 photos of yawns to analyse.

facts.fact: Giovanni 心里真正的研究对象是他的「传说」——Neverland，哈欠只是自我麻痹。
第三节：Luca 在医护手里问起 Giulio，得到的口气等于告诉他 Giulio 死了。
facts.anchor: Luca asks about Giulio, and they say, he’s badly injured. They use the tone that means, he’s badly dead, dude.

facts.fact: Luca 把某个人贴着他耳朵说的那句话一字不差地复述给穿领带的小个子男人。
facts.anchor: “Tell them he’s coming back,” Luca repeats, word for word.

facts.fact: 章末：穿领带的小个子男人并没有听懂这句话。
facts.anchor: If he thinks the little man understands, he is to be disappointed.
